name: Ground rover
summary: A four-wheel base with a bench test script. Not tested outdoors.

safety.text: The wheels turn as soon as the test starts. Test with the rover raised off the table.

steps.title: Assemble the base
steps.body: Fix the four motors to the chassis and check the wheels turn freely.

steps.title: Run the bench test
steps.body: Start the test script with the rover raised. Each wheel should turn once, in turn.
